claim: every .agents/skills/*/SKILL.md carries a machine-readable contract that PARSES and passes structural validation (required keys, allowed class_envelope values, forge-relative side_effects_write_paths)
note: This is the runtime probe for the skill contracts themselves. Exit 0 only if ALL contracts validate; one bad envelope value or one absolute/'..' write path fails the census. Parsing works with or without pyyaml -- a minimal loader covers the restricted subset and both paths are normalized to identical output.

claim: the class-preauthorization envelope gate refuses a SEND/PUBLISH/SPEND or requires_operator_sign or preauth:instance skill WITHOUT an operator signature, and executes the same skill WITH one
note: Tested in BOTH directions against a tmp_path fixture whose runner leaves a filesystem marker -- so 'it was blocked' is proven by the ABSENT side effect, not by parsing stdout. A gate tested only in the refusing direction could be a gate that refuses everything.

claim: N result files are compressed into ONE synthesis under a hard 400-word budget, without crashing on missing or malformed sources
note: Reads the live facade chain. Missing/malformed sources land under '## Unreadable sources' and the synthesis still ships.

claim: chains/OLRUN_FACADE.jsonl is written append-only with monotonic row_ids and a host-read clock; prior row bytes are never rewritten
note: Asserts the on-disk bytes of row 1 are a strict prefix of the file after row 2 is appended, and that ts_utc matches an ISO8601Z shape produced at write time rather than a literal.
